input_modes.RAW_PRIMARY_BYTES: Requires local vault asset + checksum + byte-level parser receipt.
input_modes.NORMALIZED_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT: May preserve facts already normalized from a verified source but cannot claim byte-level parsing.
input_modes.NORMALIZED_OBSERVATION: Portable observation with source locator; no raw-byte custody claim.

rules: raw_byte_verified=true requires a source SHA-256 and vault asset reference.
Parser output never increases geometry authority beyond its input observation.
Interpretive actions must remain distinguishable from direct physical observations.
